_note: 083-group-delimiter-resolution T064/T066 SEED baseline — linux-clang-RELEASE (2026-08-01). FR-022 path 2 (typed read). Same A/B method as validate_group_bench.json: the SAME bench file built against the PRE-083 library at merge-base 0539b56d. VERDICT: path 2 is WITHIN budget on the one comparable row. The two mode-(c) rows have NO pre-083 counterpart — on the pre-083 library the fixture SPLIT INTO 1 SLICE where the dictionary declares 2 and 8 (the C-8.0c extent truncation, 485 shipped contexts), and the bench's own warm-up shape check refused to time it. That refusal is itself the live demonstration that the mode-(c) requirement is load-bearing: without it this bench would have silently reported the truncated one-slice path's number.

benchmarks.name: BM_TypedReadGroup_Flat2
benchmarks.fixture: ordinary group, 2 instances — the C-8.0c descent probe runs per instance and answers FALSE both times (pure added-probe cost, no recursion)
benchmarks.verdict: WITHIN — C-8.0c's extra per-instance group_member_fn_ evaluation is ~2 ns/instance on the not-taken arm

benchmarks.name: BM_TypedReadGroup_ModeC2
benchmarks.fixture: FR-021 mode (c), 2 instances — the outer delimiter IS nested group 200's count tag, so the descent probe answers TRUE and recurses
benchmarks.pre083_status: WRONG RESULT — split into 1 slice, expected 2 (extent truncated); the bench refused to time it
benchmarks.verdict: NEW CORRECTNESS — more work because it is now right, not because it regressed

benchmarks.name: BM_TypedReadGroup_ModeC8
benchmarks.fixture: the same mode-(c) shape at 8 instances — separates the per-instance term from the fixed per-materialization term
benchmarks.pre083_status: WRONG RESULT — split into 1 slice, expected 8
benchmarks.verdict: NEW CORRECTNESS. Derived per-instance cost from the two measured mode-(c) points: (1643-661)/6 = ~164 ns per additional outer instance, which is the descent + nested-extent recursion, not an assertion
